items.title: Iraq: Battle of Haifa Street begins; in the next three days more than 120 people are killed, mostly insurgents.

Former South African President Nelson Mandela breaks a strong taboo when he announces that the death at age 54 of his sole surviving son, Makgatho Mandela, was caused by AIDS, which kills about 600 people daily in South Africa.
M 7.0 - 63 km ESE of Hachinohe, Japan
